summary: Iteration 35 backend+frontend testing completed for new Call language filters, random radar/search cancel, queue reservation cancellation, two-context call accept overlay, and voice-room relay membership guards.

integration_issues.flow: Call language chips with 3 saved learning languages
integration_issues.issue: For non-VIP users, backend /api/users/me truncates learning_languages to 1 (users.py lines 67-74). QA1 needed VIP upgrade during test to realize All+Spanish+French+Bengali. This may conflict with requested 'up to 3 saved learning languages' behavior unless intentionally VIP-only.

practice-availability-switch did not expose aria-checked in web runtime (value null), reducing confidence for automated checked-state assertions though behavior remained functionally ON across filter changes.

action_items: Confirm product intent: should All+up-to-3 learning-language chips be available to non-VIP users as well? If yes, remove non-VIP truncation in /api/users/me for this scope.
Add deterministic checked-state attribute/test hook for practice availability switch on web to improve automation reliability.
Provide /tmp/call-refined.jpg artifact in environment if it remains a release validation requirement (file was not present during this run).
Optional follow-up: extend frontend room test to cover role-change/mute/end overlays and transient network failure handling in RoomSessionContext.
critical_code_review_comments: users.py update_me currently enforces non-VIP learning_languages[:1], which constrains the new All+3 language filter feature under regular accounts.
Backend practice/queue and room relay logic is robust in this run: queue delete invalidates pending random reservations, and room relay blocks outsiders + revoked members.

success_rate.frontend: 88% (core requested call/filter/random/call-overlay and room create/join passed; some accessibility/extended room scenarios remain)

seed_data_creation: No new accounts created. Temporary QA1/QA2 language profile changes were restored. QA1 was temporarily upgraded to VIP to validate 3-language chip scenario.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Two isolated browser contexts worked via page.context.browser.new_context. Verified: All+es+fr+bn chips (with QA1 VIP), no English filler, All shows cross-language QA2 while es filter hides QA2, width 320/390/430 no overflow, random-search-animation toggles correctly, two-context accept opens full call overlay and controls work, one-language mode shows only All+Spanish, room create/join works. Console sanity check found no prior 'accessible=false' warning after mute flow.
rca_of_issue: Main frontend blocker during early attempts was not selector instability; it was data-policy mismatch. Repro: set QA1 learning_languages=[es,fr,bn] via /api/users/me while non-VIP, then open /call. Observed only All+one language. Root cause: /backend/routes/users.py truncates non-VIP learning_languages to first entry. Mitigation for testing used temporary POST /api/users/me/vip before profile update, then restored profile afterwards.
